# OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo

> Reusable Cairo smart contract components, interfaces, utilities and presets for Starknet.

The repository links below describe `main`, which may include unreleased changes. For installed
packages, read the README, package manifests, catalogs and examples at the matching release tag
instead of `main` (for example `v4.0.1`). The testing package uses its own
`openzeppelin_testing-v<version>` tags; interfaces and utilities also declare independent
package versions. Select the matching version in the hosted documentation. Architecture and
contributor guides describe the development branch and may not exist in older tags.
Always use the current audit index: each report identifies the commit and scope it covers.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/README.md): installation and ERC20 quickstart
- [Workspace manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/Scarb.toml): toolchain, editions, packages and dependency versions
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): package boundaries, composition and constraints
- [Guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/GUIDELINES.md): coding and testing conventions for contributors

## Package catalogs

- [openzeppelin_access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/access/README.md): Ownership and role-based permissions
- [openzeppelin_account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/account/README.md): Starknet accounts and account extensions
- [openzeppelin_finance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/finance/README.md): Vesting
- [openzeppelin_governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/governance/README.md): Governor, votes, timelock and multisig
- [openzeppelin_interfaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/interfaces/README.md): Shared ABI traits and dispatchers
- [openzeppelin_introspection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/introspection/README.md): SRC5 interface introspection
- [openzeppelin_merkle_tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/merkle_tree/README.md): Merkle proof verification
- [openzeppelin_presets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/presets/README.md): Deployable contract presets
- [openzeppelin_security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/security/README.md): Initialization, pausing and reentrancy protection
- [openzeppelin_token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/token/README.md): Token standards and extensions
- [openzeppelin_upgrades](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/upgrades/README.md): Contract class upgrades
- [openzeppelin_utils](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/utils/README.md): Cryptography, deployment and data structures
- [openzeppelin_macros](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/macros/README.md): Procedural macros; add as a separate dependency
- [openzeppelin_testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/testing/README.md): Foundry helpers; add as a separate dev dependency

## Examples and API reference

- [Preset contracts](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/tree/main/packages/presets/src): deployable component compositions
- [Test mocks](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/tree/main/packages/test_common/src/mocks): integration and extension examples
- [Contracts Wizard](https://wizard.openzeppelin.com/cairo): generate a contract from selected components
- [Documentation](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts-cairo): guides and versioned API reference
- [ERC20 API reference](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts-cairo/4.x/api/erc20): token interfaces, components and extension APIs
- [Testing API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/packages/testing/docs/SUMMARY.md): generated reference for the testing package

## Audits and security

- [Audit index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/audits/README.md): report PDFs, release, commit, auditor and scope
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
